in_hebrew.name: שכטי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: One who has been forced to leave his homeland and live as an exile in a foreign land.

in_greek.name: Σκόττος
in_greek.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word for 'shadow', Scotty could represent someone who is hidden, elusive, or even mysterious.

in_latin.name: Scottus
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin derivative of the word 'scandere', meaning 'to climb' or 'to ascend', Scotty could symbolize someone who has embarked on a journey to seek new heights or explore new lands.
